skills.title: Mining
skills.description: +5% mining speed per rank while holding a pickaxe; tool harvest requirements still apply.
research_bonuses: +5% mining speed per rank while holding a pickaxe; tool harvest requirements still apply.

skills.title: Deep Mining
skills.description: +5% mining speed per rank while holding a pickaxe below Y=0 (player position).
research_bonuses: +5% mining speed per rank while holding a pickaxe below Y=0 (player position).

skills.title: Stone Mining
skills.description: +4% mining speed per rank on TFC raw stone with a pickaxe; maximum +20%.
research_bonuses: +4% mining speed per rank on TFC raw stone with a pickaxe; maximum +20%.

skills.title: Excavating
skills.description: +3% mining speed per rank with a shovel on shovel-mineable blocks; maximum +15%.
research_bonuses: +3% mining speed per rank with a shovel on shovel-mineable blocks; maximum +15%.

skills.title: Careful Eye
skills.description: 0.2 percentage points per rank to find a rock-appropriate gem when mining eligible natural TFC raw stone; maximum 1%. Player-placed and piston-moved stone is excluded.
research_bonuses: 0.2 percentage points per rank to find a rock-appropriate gem when mining eligible natural TFC raw stone; maximum 1%. Player-placed and piston-moved stone is excluded.

skills.title: Excavation Reach
skills.description: +0.5 block interaction reach per rank only while holding a pickaxe or shovel in your main hand; maximum +2.5 blocks.
research_bonuses: +0.5 block interaction reach per rank only while holding a pickaxe or shovel in your main hand; maximum +2.5 blocks.

skills.title: Heights Training
skills.description: +0.5 blocks of fall-distance reduction per rank; maximum 2.5 blocks. Deep drops still hurt.
research_bonuses: +0.5 blocks of fall-distance reduction per rank; maximum 2.5 blocks. Deep drops still hurt.

skills.title: Tool Conservation
skills.description: 3% chance per rank to prevent a complete TFC pickaxe/shovel mining wear charge; maximum 15%, doubled to 30% during Brutish Mining.
research_bonuses: 3% chance per rank to prevent a complete TFC pickaxe/shovel mining wear charge; maximum 15%, doubled to 30% during Brutish Mining.

skills.title: Careful Mining
skills.description: 10% relative reduction per rank in the chance of initiating a mining collapse; maximum 50%. Does not stop ongoing collapses.
research_bonuses: 10% relative reduction per rank in the chance of initiating a mining collapse; maximum 50%. Does not stop ongoing collapses.

skills.title: Mine Safety
skills.description: Sneak-right-click a block with a pickaxe to inspect nearby unsupported collapse candidates. Radius grows from 0 to 4 blocks; 5-second cooldown. This is an assessment, not a safety guarantee.
research_bonuses: Sneak-right-click a block with a pickaxe to inspect nearby unsupported collapse candidates. Radius grows from 0 to 4 blocks; 5-second cooldown. This is an assessment, not a safety guarantee.

skills.title: Hazard Management
skills.description: Emergency shores gain 10 percentage points per rank from the triggering miner. Copper unlocks at I (10% base); black steel at IV (45% base). Each attempt consumes the shore.
research_bonuses: Emergency shores gain 10 percentage points per rank from the triggering miner. Copper unlocks at I (10% base); black steel at IV (45% base). Each attempt consumes the shore.

skills.title: Brutish Mining
skills.description: Press B to toggle +50/100/150/200/250% mining speed with 3/3.5/4/4.5/5x TFC pickaxe/shovel wear. Requires Mining IV; doubles Tool Conservation.
research_bonuses: Press B to toggle +50/100/150/200/250% mining speed with 3/3.5/4/4.5/5x TFC pickaxe/shovel wear. Requires Mining IV; doubles Tool Conservation.
